use std::ops::Add;

pub struct Point {
    x: i32,
}

impl Add for Point {
    type Output = Point;

    fn add(self, o: Point) -> Point {
        Point { x: self.x + o.x }
    }
}

pub struct Limits;

impl Limits {
    const MAX: u32 = 8;
    const UNUSED: u32 = 1;
    pub const OPEN: u32 = 2;

    fn cap(&self) -> u32 {
        Self::MAX
    }

    fn make() -> u32 {
        0
    }
}

pub trait Shape {
    const SIDES: u32;
    type Unit;

    fn sides(&self) -> u32 {
        Self::SIDES
    }
}

impl Shape for Limits {
    const SIDES: u32 = 4;
    type Unit = u8;
}

type Alias = Point;

mod inner {
    pub type Id = u32;

    pub fn id() -> Id {
        1
    }
}

fn main() {
    let a: Alias = Alias { x: 1 } + Alias { x: 2 };
    let n = Limits.cap() + Limits::OPEN;
    let m = <Limits>::make();
    inner::id();
    Limits.sides();
}
